chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 276 – The Windwing Revelation: Ji Ning’s Yuchi Heritage Exposed
chapter_meta_description: The celebration turns to blood when Shao Yanong recognizes the Windwing Evasion. Ji Ning’s mother is outed as Yuchi Snow. A clan’s bloody history erupts into the present.
og_title: The Banquet Turns Deadly – A Xianxia Clan Feud Unleashed
og_description: Ji Ning’s heritage is exposed at the worst possible moment. Shao Yanong’s mask drops, and centuries of blood feud explode into the open.
twitter_title: Ji Ning’s Mother Is Named – And War Begins
twitter_description: Xue Hongyi drops the name that starts a war. Shao Yanong orders Ji Ning’s death. The Windwing Evasion’s bloody past resurfaces.

lore_anchors.definition: A movement-type divine ability unique to the Yuchi clan, later stolen and reconstructed by the Shao Yan clan through soul-scouring their victims. Grants supreme speed and spatial mobility.
A magic treasure that suppresses all divine power and physical strength, rendering a cultivator as helpless as a mortal. Used here to demand Ji Ning’s unconditional surrender.
A forbidden interrogation technique where a powerful cultivator forcibly extracts memories from a victim’s soul, typically resulting in permanent soul damage or oblivion.
In Xianxia culture, the extermination of an entire clan creates an eternal blood debt. Remnants are hunted without mercy, and the act of vengeance is considered a sacred duty by both sides.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Shao Yanong suddenly want Ji Ning dead?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He recognizes the Windwing Evasion and learns Ji Ning's mother is Yuchi Snow, confirming Ji Ning is a remnant of a clan his family exterminated. This makes Ji Ning a blood-debt enemy by default.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Soulchain of Imprisonment?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A binding treasure that completely suppresses a cultivator's power. Ji Ning refusing to lock himself is a declaration that he will not submit to judgment—which is effectively a declaration of defiance.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't Nine Lotos stop the conflict?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Even the Dongyan clan can't override a blood-feud claim backed by a stolen divine ability. Shao Yanong is acting on clan law, and Nine Lotos's political capital can only delay, not prevent, the execution order.
